messages:
Emma Chen: Hi team, quick access problem. I can log into Okta and 1Password, but getting 403 on the shared folder 'research-weights' in Drive. Joined onboarding earlier. Anyone know who owns that share?
Priya Patel: Welcome Emma! Can you paste the folder link and confirm the Drive account email shown?
Emma Chen: Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ResearchExample Link, and the account is emma.chen@redwood.com.
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning summary: okta_user_created emma.chen@redwood.com at 2026-03-24T10:02:01Z; google_account_ready at 2026-03-24T10:03:00Z; 1password_invite sent.
Samir Rao: Heads up: onboarding group is 'eng-onboard' for the first day; folder is shared to 'eng-research'. Looks like the group promotion job didn't run for a few users.
Priya Patel: I can add you to eng-research now to unblock. Also filing a ticket to rerun the group-sync.
Emma Chen: Thanks! After you add me, will the access be immediate?
Samir Rao: Should be immediate, but Drive sometimes caches. If you still see 403 after a minute, try an incognito window.
Priya Patel: Added emma.chen@redwood.com to eng-research. Ticket #IT-4721 created: "group-sync failed for new hires 2026-03-24".
Emma Chen: Confirmed I can open the folder now. Appreciate the fast help. One more: do I need to register an MFA method in Okta now?
Priya Patel: If you haven't finished MFA, go to Okta -> Profile -> Extra Verification Methods to finish passkey or TOTP. Ping me if anything fails.
Emma Chen: Got it, will do. Thanks everyone! :tada:
